name: Pernice 2023 GreatNector Alemtuzumab MS Petri Net ODE
description: Full public-source deterministic ODE expansion of the Pernice et al. 2023 GreatNector multiple-sclerosis alemtuzumab Petri Net. The runtime reconstructs the GreatMod Petri Net places, colored Th1/Th17 transitions, generated C++ rate functions, parameter sets, alemtuzumab pulse events, and source RData trace overlays.

ATZ.description: Alemtuzumab pulse state from the GreatNector Petri Net.
ATZ.name: Alemtuzumab amount in GreatMod ATZ units

Teff_in.description: Effector T cells inside the blood-brain-barrier compartment.
Teff_in.name: CNS effector T cells

Teff_out_t1.description: Expanded colored Petri Net Teff_out state for Th1.
Teff_out_t1.name: Peripheral Th1 effector T cells

Teff_out_t17.description: Expanded colored Petri Net Teff_out state for Th17.
Teff_out_t17.name: Peripheral Th17 effector T cells

Treg_in.description: Regulatory T cells inside the blood-brain-barrier compartment.
Treg_in.name: CNS regulatory T cells

antigen_entry_mode.description: 0 uses AntigEntry from GenTransitions.cpp; 1 uses the alternate Gaussian AntigEntry from GenTransitions_2.cpp.
antigen_entry_mode.name: Antigen-entry transition mode

validation_run_nonce.name: Validation replay nonce
validation_run_nonce.description: Inert cache-busting parameter used only to force fresh exact validation API jobs.
